_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in complacency band with sideways leg, flat funding, and no printed breaker; coil base rate favors HOLD until fear/greed or ETF/price confirms a rung step.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative flow print is neutral-to-cautious and does not assert a directional phase shift
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound, fear/greed ~45-60, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: fear/greed <40 on sharp drop, or ETF flows rebound with price break and fear/greed >65
